description: AMP-Indicadores Marítimo Portuario Enero - Agosto 2020 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Presenta el resumen del movimiento de contenedores en unidades y TEU, la carga en toneladas métricas (puertos privados y estatales) el movimiento de vehículos, el movimiento de pasajeros domésticos, el movimiento de pasajeros de cruceros, las licencias emitidas a oficiales y carné de marinos de aguas internacionales de la Gente de Mar. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Its tags are Contenedores, Estadísticas de Gobierno, Indicadores, Logistica, Marítimo. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
